name: Riot Client
layout_summary: When signed out: left white panel has USERNAME, PASSWORD inputs and red arrow submit button; right side is artwork. When signed in: left vertical sidebar has All Games grid icon and game icons (League of Legends, VALORANT, Teamfight Tactics); selected game page has a prominent red/blue 'PLAY' (or 'UPDATE') button at bottom-left and profile avatar at top-right.
avoid_traps: Once League of Legends is launched from Riot Client, a separate 'League of Legends' client window opens — switch to the league_of_legends playbook for lobby/queue actions.
Do NOT click background promotional banners in the center — click the big 'PLAY' button at bottom-left.

select_game.primary: smart_click('game icon on left sidebar or game card for League of Legends / VALORANT / Teamfight Tactics')
select_game.visual_fallback: smart_click('All Games grid icon at top-left') -> smart_click('target game card')
select_game.verify: The selected game splash screen with the PLAY button is displayed

launch_game.primary: smart_click('big red or blue PLAY button at bottom-left')
launch_game.visual_fallback: smart_click('PLAY button on selected game page')
launch_game.verify: Game client launches or PLAY button changes to 'Game is Running'

open_settings.visual_fallback: smart_click('avatar button at top-right corner') -> smart_click('Settings')
open_settings.verify: Account menu or Settings modal opens

sign_in.primary: smart_type('USERNAME input in left login panel', username, submit=false) -> smart_type('PASSWORD input in left login panel', password, submit=true)
sign_in.visual_fallback: smart_click('red arrow login button at bottom of left panel')
sign_in.verify: Riot Client logs in and transitions to the games home view
